title: Introducing Nubimancy: Where Fantasy Storytelling Meets Real Business Central Development
summary: Nubimancy is a fantasy storytelling framework for teaching Business Central development that wraps real AL code, architecture patterns, and best practices in a narrative where five retired adventurers run businesses demonstrating different BC modules. The project combines technical rigor with engaging story-based learning to make complex concepts more memorable and accessible.
key_points: Five hero characters each run businesses showcasing specific BC domains: warehouse management, fixed assets/service, projects, CRM, and analytics
Real, production-quality AL code and multi-app architecture are built to solve actual business problems within the fantasy narrative
Story-based learning improves retention and accessibility compared to traditional technical documentation alone
Four-phase roadmap from foundation through community learning, with Phase 2 focusing on BC extension ecosystem currently underway
